rules.statement: Every major factual assertion must display tangible documentation (whitepaper, log excerpt, code repo, benchmark table) within 2.5 seconds of narration.
Never allow two identical visual medium types to play back-to-back for more than 2 consecutive shots (streak limit <= 2).
In software and computer-use scenes, show physical cursor navigation, keystrokes, active buffer updates, or terminal streaming rather than static application screenshots.
Human figures must have clear narrative intent (exhaustion, disbelief, hesitation, observation) rather than acting as decorative stock figures.
Shot lengths must vary dynamically between 1.2 seconds (rapid terminal montage) and 7.5 seconds (deliberate evidence scrutiny), never locking into rigid 3.0s or 5.0s uniform intervals.
No rainbow neon or unmotivated high-saturation chromatic aberration. Maintain clinical, investigative restraint.
